fields.description: MONARCH Platform is Johnson & Johnson MedTech's clinician-controlled robotically assisted bronchoscopy platform. The August 2026 MONARCH QUEST 3 announcement describes a software update with AI-powered nodule segmentation, improved registration and navigation accuracy, a 3D Compass overlay, continuous visualization, navigation to and biopsy of targets under direct vision, and correction for CT-to-body divergence. QUEST 3 is a software release, not a new physical robot. The reviewed release publishes no numeric platform price, mass, dimensions, payload, speed, runtime, charge duration, release year or IP rating; no autonomous surgery or universal clinical indication is claimed.

Payload capacity is 70 lb (32 kg) internal, 20 lb (9 kg) per wing tip and 35 lb (15.9 kg) per wing station. The airframe is 10.8 ft (3.3 m) long, 2 ft (0.6 m) high with a 6.2 ft (1.9 m) wingspan; dry weight is 130 lb (59 kg) and maximum launch weight 320 lb (145 kg). Pneumatic land or ship launch, manual or pre-programmed flight and parachute recovery are documented; first unveiled in 2011.
